Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Documents for Bid Qualification It is essential for all bidders to submit the following documents along with their bids for evaluation and det ermination of eligibility: 1. Experience Certificate – Documentary proof of relevant experience in execution of similar works/s ervices, as specified in the tender conditions. 2. Turnover Proof – Documentary evidence of the prescribed annual turnover, such as audited financ ial statements, CA-certified turnover certificate, or other acceptable documents as specified in the t ender. 3. Statutory Registration Documents – Copies of the following: PAN Card GST Registration Certificate Cancelled Cheque 4. Proof of Service Provider's Presence in Kerala – Documentary proof establishing that the bidde r/service provider has an office/establishment/service facility in the State of Kerala, as required u nder the tender conditions. 5. Dedicated Toll-Free Number – Documentary proof/details of a dedicated toll-free customer/servic e support number available for providing support to the client. 6. Financial Standing – Documentary proof demonstrating the bidder's financial soundness and capa city to execute the contract, such as a solvency certificate, banker's certificate, audited financial sta tements, or other documents prescribed in the tender conditions. Note: Non-submission of any of the above mandatory documents may render the bid liable for rejection d uring the technical/eligibility evaluation, subject to the provisions of the tender document and applicable pr ocurement rules. .
